content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 19, ¶p0133).**

Section 19 imposes a mutual **no-hire** — "agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party" — covering all employees of the other party, extending to affiliates, and with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. No-hire provisions and restrictions covering all personnel are walk-away items under NOSOLICIT, so the clause fails the fallback despite its acceptable 12-month tail.

Redline (validated, fallback level): converted to a solicitation-only restriction, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, running 12 months from the end of that involvement, with express carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and confirmation that hiring as such is not restricted. We kept the clause mutual rather than deleting it, since mutuality is already part of the bargain and full deletion would be disproportionate here.
